electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Primary brand color — filled CTAs, full-bleed feature section background, icon accents, the credit card product visual's gradient. Carries 80% of brand recognition

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Orange action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, dark card surfaces (the credit card mockup, the dark feature section), heavy borders. Not pure black — sits slightly warm

midnight.$description: Midnight — Secondary text and dark borders when Ink Black feels too heavy in tight contexts

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary canvas, card surfaces, button text, input fills — the bright default that lets blue and orange speak

parchment.$description: Parchment — Warm card surface alternative — used when a card needs to feel softer than pure white, typically for feature blocks or stat panels

sand.$description: Sand — Warm hairline border, parchment-adjacent dividers, subtle card outlines that need warmth without darkness

graphite.$description: Graphite — Border color for dark elements, secondary dividers on dark surfaces

steel.$description: Steel — Muted helper text, quiet borders, icon strokes that need to recede

ash.$description: Ash — Muted text and borders on warm surfaces, slightly lighter than Steel for secondary hierarchy

fog.$description: Fog — Input default border — the resting state before focus activates the Electric Blue ring

inter.$description: Primary typeface for all functional UI: body, nav, buttons, labels, stats, card titles. Weight 600 for headings, 500 for sub-labels, 400 for body, 700 for stat numbers. The workhorse that does 95% of the work.

gambetta.$description: Italic display serif reserved for the single most important word in the hero headline — a deliberate voice break that turns a product descriptor into editorial copy. Used at most once per page.

system-ui.$description: system-ui — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
